# Tasks: Issue #545 — Closing Reference Coverage

## Review Workload Forecast

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Estimated changed lines | ~900-1100 (2 providers, run-check.mjs, normalize.mjs, issue-ref-patterns.mjs, contract doc, 6 fixtures, contract+unit+mutation tests) |
| 400-line budget risk | High |
| Chained PRs recommended | Yes |
| Suggested split | PR1 → PR2 → PR3 → PR4 |
| Delivery strategy | auto-chain |
| Chain strategy | feature-branch-chain |

Decision needed before apply: No
Chained PRs recommended: Yes
Chain strategy: feature-branch-chain
400-line budget risk: High

### Suggested Work Units

| Unit | Goal | PR (base) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Verb registration + normalize helper + fixtures + GitLab shape check | PR1 (feature/issue-545) | Gate task 0 first, ~200 lines |
| 2 | GitHub + GitLab transport bodies + contract tests | PR2 (PR1) | ~350 lines |
| 3 | run-check.mjs gate wiring + memory-gate OR + regex twins | PR3 (PR2) | ~250 lines |
| 4 | Regression, negative-control, no-fallback, mutation tests | PR4 (PR3) | ~300 lines |

## Phase 0: Gate (blocking — do first, before any other task)

- [ ] 0.1 Confirm `brain/scripts/vcs/lib/uncomputable-cause.mjs` exists on this branch's base, or that #606's branch IS the base. If absent: **STOP and report to the maintainer.** Do not fork the shape, do not stub it (design §0.1).

## Phase 1: Foundation (PR1)

- [ ] 1.1 `vcs/lib/normalize.mjs`: add `normalizeClosingSet`, `MAX_CLOSING_REFS` (design §1.6).
- [ ] 1.2 Register `prClosingIssues` in one commit: `cli.mjs` VERBS, `vcs-contract.md` Required Verbs table, both provider exports (design §7).
- [ ] 1.3 Record `github-prClosingIssues-{happy,empty}.json` from live query against PR #592/#502 (design §7).
- [ ] 1.4 GitLab shape check: confirm `closes_issues` response against a real MR or published API ref for the installed major version BEFORE pinning any GitLab fixture; mark `_provenance` recorded/derived honestly (design §3.1 — unverified today, non-negotiable).
- [ ] 1.5 Derive remaining fixtures: `gitlab-prClosingIssues-*` per 1.4's outcome, `{github,gitlab}-prClosingIssues-failure.json`.

## Phase 2: Provider Transports (PR2, base PR1)

- [ ] 2.1 `github.mjs`: implement `prClosingIssues` — non-interpolated module-constant GraphQL query, `ghJson` chokepoint, `-F number=`, case-insensitive local/foreign split (design §2).
- [ ] 2.2 `gitlab.mjs`: implement `prClosingIssues` — `GET closes_issues`, page-2-only-on-full-page overflow, `references.relative` locality rule (design §3.2).
- [ ] 2.3 Both providers: overflow → `uncomputable({reason: TRUNCATED})`; add `TRUNCATED` to `UNCOMPUTABLE_REASONS` — the one licensed enum edit (design §1.4).
- [ ] 2.4 `vcs.contract.test.mjs`: happy/empty/failure/foreign/overflow/argv-pinning/source-guard, table-driven both providers (design §8.1-7).
- [ ] 2.5 `normalize.test.mjs`: sort/dedupe/freeze determinism (M6).

## Phase 3: Gate Wiring (PR3, base PR2)

- [ ] 3.1 `run-check.mjs`: add `resolveClosingTargets` — slice path stays regex-only, byte-identical to today; default-branch path via `prClosingIssues`; refusal order uncomputable → foreign → empty (design §4.2).
- [ ] 3.2 `run-check.mjs`: add `refuse.{unreadable,foreign,platformSeesNone,memberFetch,noPrNumber}` builders (design §5).
- [ ] 3.3 `run-check.mjs`: sequential loop over `targets`, first unapproved target fails the gate; import `isUncomputable` only, never the classifier (design §4.2, §0.1).
- [ ] 3.4 `issue-ref-patterns.mjs`: derive `CLOSING_RE_G`/`CHAIN_RE_G` from base constants; `run-check.mjs`: `extractIssueNumbers` plural, `extractIssueNumber` delegates (design §6.2).
- [ ] 3.5 `run-check.mjs`: `runMemoryGateCheck` permissive-OR over the regex set only; MUST NOT call `fetchClosingIssues` — `SUBCOMMAND_PORT_REACH['memory-gate']` stays `false` (design §6.1, §6.3).

## Phase 4: Tests & Mutations (PR4, base PR3)

- [ ] 4.1 PR #592 regression test: platform set `{closes:[477,591]}`, #477 approved, #591 not → gate FAILS naming #591; call log proves both were fetched (design §9 M0 — its own task).
- [ ] 4.2 Negative control: multi-target PR where every target is approved → PASSES. This is the shape 10/100 of the last merged PRs match; it must not block (design §9 M3 — its own task).
- [ ] 4.3 No-silent-fallback test: platform read fails → uncomputable refusal, zero issue fetches, exit 2; a mutation to a regex fallback must go RED on all three axes (design §5.6, §9 M1/M1b/M9).
- [ ] 4.4 Default-branch condition test: slice-shaped body (#502/#503/#504 pattern) on a non-default target resolves via regex, byte-identical to pre-change behavior, including a slice PR that says `Closes #N`; the existing slice suite (`run-check.test.mjs:834-976`) stays green **unedited** (design §4.3, §9 M4/M4b).
- [ ] 4.5 `memory-gate` OR tests: a record scoped to the 2nd-of-2 target passes; single-target result `deepEqual`s `memoryRetrieval` directly; a hostile dep throws if `fetchClosingIssues` is ever called (design §9 M7/M8/M8b).
- [ ] 4.6 Remaining mutation coverage: M2 (non-interpolated query), M5/M5b (empty ≠ uncomputable), M10/M11 (per-provider failure isolation), M12 (foreign never verified locally), M13 (cap refuses, not truncates), M14 (no hand-rolled uncomputable literal — #606's source guard), M15 (regex precedence unchanged on slices).

## Gate status at planning time
`brain/scripts/vcs/lib/uncomputable-cause.mjs` does NOT exist in this worktree (`/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-545`) as of this tasks phase — confirmed via glob/grep, zero matches. Task 0.1 must be re-checked at apply time since #606 may land before #545's apply runs; if still absent, apply must STOP per design §0.1, not fork or stub the shape.
